text: これからも　もっと　がんばって　ほしいっす　ウスッ！
note: ウスッ is the shout "osu" (押忍), the greeting and all-purpose "yes, sir" of karate and other martial-arts dojos, which marks the speaker as a dojo student. The English game replaced it with "Hiyah!".
claim: Osu (押忍) is a greeting and affirmation used in Japanese martial arts such as karate.

check.quote: 押忍（おす、おっす）とは、主に空手道・剣道・柔道などの武道の関係者の間で非公式で使われる挨拶の一つ。
